resources.string: Circle Japanese on screen. Read it offline.
Add the Gaten tile from your quick settings editor.
Tap the bubble on screen to look up.
Send a broadcast with this action:
The built-in reader (ML Kit) is reading your screen. Installing a model below makes the stylized lettering it misreads readable.

ML Kit finds the lines on screen; manga-ocr reads them, including the stylized fonts it misreads — outlined video-thumbnail text, hand-lettered manga lettering. Any line it cannot read (no model, a failure, or a slow answer) keeps ML Kit’s text. Everything runs on the device: the only network requests Gaten makes are downloading an optional model, here or below, and only when you ask for one. A model already on your phone can be imported instead.
About %1$d MB will be downloaded from huggingface.co. Use Wi-Fi if you can.
You are on mobile data. About %1$d MB will be downloaded from huggingface.co — use Wi-Fi if you can.
Import failed: encoder, decoder and vocab files are all needed

Gaten can translate the lines you select into English on the device, and shows the selected text next to the translation. The language models are downloaded from Google when you tap Download, and then work offline — in airplane mode included. This is the app’s second network request, and it happens only when you ask for it.
No progress is reported for this download, and it cannot be cancelled from here once it starts.
About %1$d MB will be downloaded from Google. Use Wi-Fi if you can.
